cues: e-medicine, or telemedicine, delivers health care at a distance: video consultation, X rays and ECGs sent to a specialist, wearable monitors, electronic records.
For Nepal the argument is geography: a Kathmandu specialist can advise a health post in Humla in minutes instead of a two day journey.
Its limits: no physical examination, it needs bandwidth and power, and patient privacy and responsibility are hard questions.
